title: WIP: Update to Go 1.27 and sigstore v1.10.10, support ML-DSA signing keys
body: Draft: description to be written later.

comments.body: As noted on https://github.com/podman-container-tools/container-libs/pull/1166 we cannot bump to go 1.27 until go 1.26 is EOL.

Also, https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/blob/main/specs/SIGNATURE_SPEC.md only specifies ECDSA, and it was an intentional design decision to have no algorithm flexibility there. Similarly there’s no sign of any MLDSA support in `cosign`.

I’m not _entirely_ ruling out that we might want to deviate from the sigstore designs, but that would need very conscious decision, not just a “this works for us” PR.

Meanwhile, https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/issues/4960 — and the proposed design for PQC is _very_ different from the current formats.
